traps.detail: SUMAX listed 2026-09-02. Any resolver keyed on the 2026-06-05 NSE equity master cannot see it on two independent axes: (a) the master predates the listing by 89 days, and (b) even a current master of that shape could not carry it, because that file holds only EQ and ETF series while SUMAX trades on an NSE Emerge SME series. Refreshing the master does NOT fix this name - the series filter does. A resolver that reports 'not found, master is stale' has diagnosed only half the failure.

Screener's annual EPS reads 220.43 / 35.35 / 47.42 / 8.66 INR for FY23-FY26 while net profit rises monotonically 5 / 7 / 10 / 13 INR crore. The EPS is computed against each year's own year-end share count, not a restated one, and equity capital went 2 / 2 / 2 / 15 INR crore. Any YoY EPS growth, EPS CAGR, PEG or 'earnings collapse' signal built on this series is pure noise - FY26 EPS is down 82% against FY25 on a year profit rose 28%.

The '52-week high/low' of 132.75 / 101.20 spans 12 trading sessions (2026-09-02 to 2026-09-18). Every aggregator labels a since-listing range as 52-week without qualification. Percentile rank, distance-from-high, and any volatility or range-based screen computed on it are meaningless for P15.

Two independent sources render nulls as literal zeros for this scrip: Groww prints 'P/E (TTM) 0.00' and 'EPS (TTM) 0.00' for a company earning INR 12.76 crore, and INDmoney prints 'Book Value: 0'. A pipeline that ingests numerically rather than checking for the null will report SUMAX as a zero-earnings, zero-book-value company - and a PE of 0.00 will sort it to the top of any 'cheapest stocks' screen.

FY26 total assets: Screener 85 INR crore vs Groww 242 INR crore - a 2.8x conflict between two sources both labelled INR crore. Borrowings likewise 13 vs 10.36. Screener's figure reconciles with revenue and net worth; Groww's does not. Any ratio with an asset denominator (asset turnover, ROA, debt/assets) flips character depending on which source fed it.

Groww's entire valuation block is one session behind its own displayed price: market cap 227 INR crore and book value 55.17 with P/B 2.17 both reconcile to the PREVIOUS close of 119.50, not the displayed LTP of 114.50. Cross-source market-cap diffs against Groww will show a phantom 4.2% gap that is purely a timing artifact.

Identical shareholding percentages (69.67 / 2.10 / 9.59 / 18.63) are labelled 'Sep 2026' by Screener and 'Aug 26' by both Groww and INDmoney. A differ keyed on the quarter label will report a period mismatch where the underlying data is identical; a differ keyed on the values will report agreement while silently picking a wrong as-of date.

NSE's chain buckets SUMAX as 'Auto Components & Equipments' under Automobile and Auto Components. The actual business is auto-REFINISH consumables - masking tapes, abrasives, polishing compounds, buffing pads, body-shop supplies - plus distribution of a Portuguese abrasives brand (INDASA). It is a consumables/distribution business wearing an auto-ancillary code. Peer sets, sector P/E comparisons (Groww shows an industry P/E of 50.90) and any sector-relative valuation are comparing it to component makers selling into OEM assembly lines. No standard taxonomy has a clean bucket for this.

Lot size 1200 shares, cut-off price INR 101, but the quoted minimum investment is INR 2,28,000 = 2 lots x 1200 x INR 95 (LOWER band). Neither 1200 x 101 = 1,21,200 nor 2 x 1200 x 101 = 2,42,400 reproduces it. A pipeline deriving lot size from min-investment/price gets ~2257 or ~2400 shares, not 1200; one deriving issue price from min-investment/lot gets INR 190 or INR 95, not 101.

Screener rounds the 52-week low to INR 101, which is numerically identical to the IPO issue price of INR 101. The true low is 101.20. The collision is coincidence - a reconciler that 'confirms' the issue price against the 52w low will appear to validate and will be wrong by 0.20.

ROE 20.2-20.71% and ROCE 25.2% are FY2026 figures - entirely pre-IPO. INR 53.40 crore of fresh equity landed in September 2026 against a June-2026 net worth near INR 62 crore, i.e. the capital base nearly doubled AFTER the ratio period. Displaying these next to a live post-money market cap implies a return profile the company no longer has.

Screener's quarterly-results table is empty for this scrip (headers render, rows do not). The benchmark this whole census diffs against has no quarterly data for P15. Absence of a diff here is not agreement.

'Sumax' is a generic brand token. Do not fuzzy-match to Sumax-named entities in other jurisdictions or to unrelated engineering firms with similar names; the only safe keys are the NSE symbol SUMAX on the Emerge SME segment and (once obtained) the ISIN. There is no BSE twin to cross-check against, which removes the usual dual-listing sanity check.

Screener's FY26 'Net Profit' 13 INR crore and Groww's FY26 'PAT' 12.76 INR crore are the same number at different rounding, but Screener's FY23 Net Profit of 5 does not reconcile to any Groww figure (Groww's table starts at FY24). Cross-source annual series overlap on only three years.

world_gaps.detail: SUMAX is an NSE Emerge SME listing only. No reachable source shows a BSE scrip code, and the IPO was an NSE-Emerge-exclusive offering. A BSE code should be reported as absent, not as missing data. Confidence high but not filing-confirmed (bseindia.com was unreachable).

The scrip is on an NSE SME series (Emerge), but the exact series code (SM vs ST) is printed only on the NSE quote page / master file, both unreachable. Recorded as SME without a letter rather than guessed - and the letter is precisely what a resolver filtering on EQ/ETF would need.

No pledge figure appears on Screener, Groww or INDmoney. Screener displays no pledged row at all for this scrip. For a company whose first shareholding pattern was filed weeks after listing, a nil/absent pledge disclosure is the expected state. Do not substitute 0.00% - absent and zero are different claims.

Dividend yield is 0.00% on both Screener and Groww and no dividend announcement appears in the filing list. The company has never declared a dividend as a listed entity (it has been listed 12 trading sessions). The 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-30 book closure is for the 32nd AGM, NOT a dividend record date.

None of the three reachable sources prints the dates on which the 132.75 high or 101.20 low occurred. Within a 12-session window these are derivable only from a daily OHLC series, which requires the NSE historical endpoint (unreachable).

Q1 FY27 revenue INR 35.68 crore and PAT INR 3.50 crore are known, but no Q1 FY26 comparative is published on any reachable source (Screener's quarterly table is empty; the press release PDF could not be opened). As a first-post-listing quarter the prior-year comparative may not have been filed at all - a pre-IPO private company had no quarterly reporting obligation - so this may be does-not-exist rather than merely unreached. Not resolved either way.
Pre-issue promoter percentage is in the RHP only. Post-issue promoter holding is known at 69.67% from the shareholding pattern. Pre-issue not sourced, not derived.

The Mar-2023-to-Mar-2026 equity-capital jump from 2 to 15 INR crore against flat reserves strongly implies a pre-IPO bonus capitalisation during FY2026, but NO reachable source names one and Groww's IPO page shows no bonus/split entry. Recorded as an observation under corporate_actions_2026.unexplained_capital_change, NOT as a corporate action. Not guessed into the actions list.
No reachable source labels the headline figures consolidated or standalone. Inference points to standalone (no subsidiary mentioned anywhere) but the field is left null rather than asserted.

Every filing referenced in this pack is cited at the URL Screener printed for it and is explicitly flagged 'PDF not opened'.
